state.paragraph: In the first week of October 2014, the Company entered into confidentiality and standstill agreements with 15 potentially interested financial buyers, all 15 of which, during the month of October engaged in due diligence, received management presentations involving the Company's senior-most management, and received detailed financial and business plan information, including detailed information concerning the Profit Improvement Plan and associated cost-saving plans and opportunities.

ledger_rows.Note: Board determined to explore strategic alternatives including a possible sale; Profit Improvement Plan; ad hoc committee to oversee; J.P. Morgan to contact parties later.
Press release announced exploration of strategic alternatives including a possible sale; uncontacted parties could approach J.P. Morgan.
Not invited: told 08/22 and 08/27 the board would not invite it; may still submit a proposal; no contact since 08/27.
Contacts: 27 parties (3 strategic not counting Industry Participant; 24 financial) approached J.P. Morgan mid-August–end October; ~15 expressed interest by the 10/03 board update.
Round 1 opened by the first-week-of-October confidentiality wave; the 10/30 indication due date was set later.
All 15 received October due diligence, management presentations and detailed financial and business-plan information.
Set non-binding preliminary indication due date of 10/30; communicated to the potential bidders during October.
Six of the potentially interested parties submitted indications of interest.
Preliminary non-binding indication; range $81.00–$83.00; consideration not stated.
Another of the six submitters; non-binding range $80.00–$85.00; not individually named.
Remainder of the six submitters; no individual detail or prices; one later advanced, two eliminated 11/03 (#24).
Raised after J.P. Morgan's 10/30–11/02 calls; range $81.00–$84.00; made it one of four at or above $80.00.
Final round opened by the 11/03 advancement of four bidders at or above $80.00; merger-agreement form circulated in November; updated FY2014 projections given to all finalists.
6 submitters − 4 advanced = 2 notified as eliminated; none could remain above their initial indications.

nda_access.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
